description: A very common, harmless dry-skin condition caused by keratin accumulation in hair follicles.
symptoms: Small rough follicular bumps may occur.
Dryness and rough texture may be present.
causes: Abnormal keratinisation of the upper portion of hair follicles.
risk_factors: Childhood and adolescence are common times of onset.
It is associated with atopic eczema and ichthyosis.
It may be more prominent in winter.

appearance.general: Small follicular keratotic papules producing a rough, sometimes erythematous skin texture.

general_first_aid: Moisturising the skin may help reduce dryness and roughness.
doctor_discussion_points: Whether the appearance is consistent with keratosis pilaris or another follicular disorder.

sources.title: Keratosis Pilaris: Symptoms, Causes, and Treatment
